cohort: 104,995 low-risk, primiparous women aged 11 to 50 years who gave birth to a live baby in an Ontario hospital between 2012 and 2018
finding: Midwifery-model care was associated with fewer unscheduled ED visits postpartum compared to traditional obstetrics-model care among low-risk, primiparous women.
mod_finding: The association between model of care and ED use differed by mode of birth, with no association observed among women who had a cesarean birth.
